activity_summary: At night you said you would not improve the letter. It is sealed, and the three beginnings stay struck. You said you are not adding the six-and-twenty to the twenty pound fifteen.

entities.name: William Shakespeare
entities.context: Said he would not improve it, and would not add the share.

entities.name: Anne Shakespeare
entities.context: Named in the letter. Not present.

entities.name: twenty pound fifteen shillings
entities.context: Mentioned in I will not improve it
